# Rule 10 - No Shuttlebombing or EORG
Shuttlebombing, the act of bombing or significantly interfering with the evacuation shuttle, is not allowed — unless you have an objective that permits it, such as “die a glorious death” (DAGD) or other mass-sabotage objectives.
It's cheap, easy, boring as hell, and doesn't lead to any interesting stories.
End-of-round griefing (EORG) — to harm other players, destroy property, or to otherwise act out-of-character specifically once the round ends — is also not allowed. Once the round-end screen appears, please stay in-character and continue to follow all the rules. - This does not include antagonists who are permitted to continue being antagonists at CentComm, though they should have an in-character reason to be causing chaos rather than being a murderhobo for the fun of it.
## Precedents - Shuttlebombing includes [bold]ANY[/bold] action that will either kill or harm indiscriminately. Examples include gas/tile fires, explosions, spells, etc. If you are unsure about how applicable this rule is towards your particular plan or objective, ask in admin help via F1 before you act. - If you order a familiar to grief the evacuation shuttle or commit EORG, you will be responsible for whatever said familiar does.
